Hi Ava / ClearShore team,

Thanks again for a great discovery earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Scope we heard: low-latency inference for interactive search, strict data residency in EU for PII, and predictable throughput for peak retail periods.
- Critical stakeholders: David Lim (IT/security), Product (you), and a technical deep-dive with your infra team.

Immediate ask: schedule the follow-up technical deep-dive (60–75 min) where we can do a short walkthrough of the Redwood runtime and then dive into your resume samples and latency targets. Because you’ve got users across US/EU/APAC, we propose a short pilot of rotating "office-hours" demo windows (one week each in a 3-week rotation) rather than one-off late-night calls. The goal is to find a repeatable cadence that minimizes after-hours burden for your team while giving real-time access to our SEs.

Attached: discovery-notes-jonas.pdf (summary) and proposed-officehours-grid.csv (3-week rotating grid with suggested UTC windows).

Proposed next steps (pick one):
1) Pick a slot from the grid and we’ll lock a technical deep-dive with our SE (Priyom) for the week of Oct 19–23.
2) If you prefer, we can run a short pilot: week A (US-friendly morning), week B (EU midday), week C (APAC evening) and we’ll schedule a single deep-dive for the window that matches your people.

Quick links: calendar poll (https://calendar.redwood.ai/poll/7f3a2e) — please add preferences before EOD Wed PT.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Priyom and Marissa on availability.

Best,
Jonas Weber
